parts.text: $NSP Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, +2% Y/Y, driven by higher pricing offsetting a drop in paid WSEEs from margin recovery efforts. Operating margin -0.1% as operating expenses fell. #earnings #industrials

$HAS Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, flat Y/Y, driven by growth in Wizards of the Coast and Digital Gaming led by Magic: The Gathering. Operating margin reached 32.4%; operating cash flow $303M. #earnings #consumer

$SNDR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +9% Y/Y, as truckload earnings doubled on network profitability and dedicated actions. Operating margin 3.9%. Raising full-year guidance. #earnings #industrials
$RBLX Q3 2026: revenue reached $1.6B, up 16% Y/Y, driven by platform activity. Operating cash flow was $395M as investments in infrastructure and safety continued. #earnings #software

$STRL Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, +127% Y/Y, driven by E-Infrastructure Solutions growth in data centers and semiconductor facilities. Operating margin 19.6%; operating cash flow $99M. #earnings #industrials

$TWLO Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +20% Y/Y, driven by broad-based strength across the product portfolio and consumer AI adoption. Operating margin 9.5%; operating cash flow $389M. #earnings #software
$INCY Q3 2026: revenue was $1.6B, up 14% Y/Y, driven by Jakafi. Operating margin fell to -45.5% as total costs outpaced revenue growth, resulting in a net loss for the period. #earnings #biotech
$VLTO Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +8% Y/Y, led by core sales growth in Water Quality water treatment solutions. Operating margin 19.7%. #earnings #industrials
$PSCO Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +5% Y/Y, supported by lower total costs and an operating margin of 28.1%. #earnings #utilities
$ALNY Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +17% Y/Y, driven by AMVUTTRA sales. Operating margin 23.7%; net earnings $2.2B supported by tax items. Operating cash flow reached $341M. #earnings #pharma
$BC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +7% Y/Y, driven by steady OEM demand with sales growth across all segments for the fifth consecutive quarter. Operating margin 5.4%. #earnings #industrials

$ATI Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +26% Y/Y, driven by strong demand and pricing in aerospace and defense markets, particularly commercial jet engine products. Operating margin 19.1%; net earnings $193M. #earnings #materials
